scope.descriptor_stats: descriptive conditional means on joint-valid sampled receivers; not held-out predictive performance
scope.multi_stats: all valid full-resolution receivers on 39 development terrains, retaining receivers with >=10 valid TX; label-dependent decomposition only
scope.normal_angle: receiver surface normal versus direct TX-RX segment, a geometry descriptor, not antenna gain
scope.roughness: RMS height residual after 9x9 or 33x33 local averaging, measured in meters; macro terrain only
